verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own docs point to a Batch Processing API for high-volume customer processing and asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios. Bulk data export across several record types is also documented. However, the batch API is only mentioned in passing, and the monitoring-configuration endpoints work on a single customer at a time. Missing for 10: documented batch API contract and limits, bulk case or alert remediation, bulk monitor or unmonitor operations, and hands-on corroboration.
